function: Prepare separate immutable T1-only actor and evaluator-private metadata contracts against the exact frozen IXI cohort. The enclosing result is evaluator-owned and never passed to an actor.
role_policy: TRAIN/SELECT/MEASUREMENT_EVAL are immutable. TRAIN check permission is not training authorization; SELECT cannot fit; MEASUREMENT_EVAL cannot fit or select. Failed/missing cases retain their original person role and denominator.
evidence_contract: Exact reviewed metadata checksum, raw-versus-derived member identity, intended-use QC scopes, available-to-actor timestamps, T1-only support/task ancestry, estimator project-fit role and retained pretrained exposure, proper directed rigid registration, and annotation/MRA/registration domain intersection.
retrospective_time: Unknown acquisition time remains null. It does not block retrospective research when T1 availability before the declared decision is independently evidenced. Unknown or late actor availability refuses preparation; private availability may remain unknown. No preoperative or simultaneous-acquisition claim.
generated_controls: All synthetic metadata remains generated_metadata_control even when joined to already-public real IXI role/member names. Changing only the envelope to real_source_receipts refuses. These assertions never establish real image QC or patient admission.
author_checks: 43 generated controls passed in 0.21s, including immutable actor/private separation, no file opens during preparation, unavailable and wrong-role cases, header-only/wrong-scope QC rejection, private ancestry, transform/frame/domain and non-biological coverage semantics.
independent_checks: 58 metadata controls passed in 0.25s: 43 author plus 15 independent controls. Final source/test/cohort hashes unchanged; patch matches exact source and unchanged canonical test bodies; patch application check passed. Independent evidence copied under independent-review/.
next_executable_bridge: next-bridge.json specifies a distinct retrospective healthy corridor task, at most two deterministic T1-derived waypoints, horizon 1 complete tool action or STOP, public reach/effort objective, reused full-history seals and private streaming scorer. Target-removal reward cannot be relabelled as waypoint reach. Existing generated 32^3 reference and 16^3 planning scorer limits remain unchanged.
limitations: This is metadata preparation, not authentication or a performed anatomy/registration/coverage check. Runtime loading must verify actual arrays and reviewed bindings through new versioned real-person code paths. No clinical, tumor, vessel-free or unseen-pretrained claim follows. No current checkpoint is assumed compatible with the new component objective.
